desc: Howard, Leonard, Sheldon, and Raj stumble though the front door of the building, covered with blue paint over paintball suits.
A shot of Sheldon walking up the stairs with a large orange paint mark on the back of his paintball suit.
Penny comes down the stairs, and is saluted by Howard.
Penny pats Sheldon on the face before walking down the stairs at the apartments.
Leonard, with a happy smile, in a Flash costume, answers the door.
Leonard touches his nose before answering the door, wearing a Flash costume.
Two guys in Flash costumes discover a third one wearing the same costume.
Raj jumps into the apartment wearing a Flash costume.
Sheldon, in a black-and-white striped costume, opens up and smells a bottle of juice in his hands.
Leonard, in a costume with a green cape, grabs a spatula from the kitchen to look at himself.
Leonard, Raj, Sheldon, and Howard, wearing their costumes, stand as Howard knocks on the door with a skeleton on it.
Penny opens the door for the boys as they wait outside in costume, and tucks her hair behind her ear.
Sheldon, Leonard, Howard, and Raj enter Penny's Halloween-decorated apartment in costumes.
Raj, in costume, smiling, raises his brown hammer.
Howard puts his foot on the coffee table and pretends to blow pixie dust.
Raj, in costume, sits on the couch and shoves a snack from the bowl into his mouth.
Howard in a costume, picks up a bow from next to his chair and sets it in his lap.
Howard talks to a girl in a nurse costume, then she touches her stethoscope.
Howard crossed his arms while talking to a woman dressed as a nurse.
Sheldon, in a costume, stands up from the couch at a Halloween party and touches his hips.
Girl wearing a pink costume with a drink in her hand makes circles with her hand in front of Sheldon's chest.
A girl dressed as a ladybug sits next to Raj on the sofa and turns her head to him.
Penny in a cat costume hugs the shirtless guy standing in front of her.
The shirtless man flirtatiously tucks a stray hair behind Penny's ear.
Penny, in a cat costume, places her hands on her hips and moves them while standing in front of a shirtless guy.
The shirtless guy walks over and rubs Leonard's hair.
Penny nudges the shirtless guy in the arm while smiling at him.
The topless guy pick up Leonard and Leonard was shocked.
The shirtless guy drops Leonard onto Sheldon and walks away.
Sheldon brings a drink in a mug to Leonard who is sitting on the couch in a costume.
Sheldon pats Leonard, who is in a costume, on the back a couple of times as Leonard sits on the couch.
Penny in a cat costume, puts her head on Leonard's shoulder while they are sitting on the couch.
Penny, in a cat costume, bursts into tears before burying her head in Leonard's neck
Penny in a cat costume, kisses Leonard as they sit on the couch.
Penny in a cat costume, kisses Leonard at the doorway of his apartment.
Leonard, in a costume, closes his front door quickly and locks his door.
A shot of a brown, big hammer near the bed with a pile of clothes on the floor.
Raj and a girl lie in bed with a flowered duvet, as he puts his hands behind his head.
